redFindings.title: Credential: Supabase DB password is missing
redFindings.body:
**Supabase DB password** is not set. Expected env: `SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD`.

What breaks: Direct psql paths used by migrations.

How to fix: Supabase dashboard, database settings.

This is one of the genuinely human-only items. A third party requires a person to authenticate, so no automation can replace it. Everything up to the rotation is already handled.
